To Pimp A ButterflyFabolous - Awwright
(prod. Pharrell Williams)
(Alright)		During Fool's Gold "Holy Ship" rap party in January 2014, Pharrell originally premiered a snippet of an unreleased Fabolous song where Loso was heard singing Kendrick's "Alright" hook. Not a "remix" in the common sense, as it shares almost the same instrumental as the jazz rendition of Kendrick's song by Terrace Martin. Loso would leak his "Alright" version on SoundCloud three months after To Pimp A Butterfly release. The track was accompanied with a music video directed by Gerard Victor on YouTube.

Drake vs. Kendrick LamarFuture & Metro Boomin - LIKE THAT (Remix)
(feat. ¥$ & The Hooligans) (prod. Metro Boomin, Future, Ethan Stevens, Kanye West & The Legendary Traxster)		OG Filename: LIKE THAT_Ye_-Traxter_W_Hooligans_...
Remix to Future and Metro Boomin's song "Like That", with vocals from Ye, Ty, and The Hooligans, alongisde new production. Future also has an alternate verse taken from the original version of the song. DJ Pharris premiered the song censored and it was posted on yeezy.com for a very short period before it was later posted on YouTube. Written by Nayvadius Cash, Leland Wayne, Rodney Oliver, Kobe "BBYKOBE" Hood, Terrance "Zona Man" George, Ye, and Tyrone Griffin, Jr.. Engineered by Eric Maco, Ethan Stevens, Kourosh "MYBOYROACH" Poursalehi, Ray Charles Brown Jr. Johnathan Turner, Victor Luevanos, Aaron Fugeri, Jacob Stewart, Kayla DeWitt, Joe Laporta, and Rafael Fai Bautista. Mixed by Metro Boomin, Ethan Stevens, Rafael Fai Bautista, and The Legendary Traxster. Possibly intended to be released on the rumored deluxe to We Don't Trust You and We Still Don't Trust You, though that is likely not releasing anymore. If the Drake Kendrick beef continued, the song would've been released a week earlier to promote the release of the album like "TALKING".
